title: Linebreak Broken for TIR values on Statistics Page
body: Hello, maybe this is only in the german translation, but there is a line-break issue with the statistics page:

comments.body: Who could have verified this before approval?  Could the person who did the translation verify this before submitting the translation?
This is a problem in other languages as well:

Do the translators only deal with words?
They have no way of verifying this themselves, right?

@Navid200 Did you every try Crowdin? It is not word based. It is the full string of an option, sentence, etc. 
This bug is not related to translation. It is a layout problem in [stats_general.xml](../blob/master/app/src/main/res/layout/stats_general.xml#L17).

No, I don't even have a Crowdin account.  
I'm just trying to understand who we should ping for this.  
If this happens only for some languages, could it be that when the length of the line becomes too long, the issue occurs, and that's why it doesn't happen in English?
Can I recreate this problem on my phone?
Just switch to Finnish or Russian to recreate it.
